e: Experimental postdoc using NV-center quantum sensing in diamond, together with transmon noise spectroscopy, to find the microscopic origins of 1/f flux and charge noise in superconducting qubits. Includes commissioning a dilution refrigerator with optical access. The posting says the hire must obtain and maintain government access authorization and must disclose foreign-government-sponsored activities under DOE O 486.1A; it gives no explicit citizenship requirement.
f: Ames National Laboratory (Iowa State University), Division of Materials Science and Engineering
